protocol: Frozen development views and estimator configuration; no post-2023/frozen benchmark rows.
selection: One final numerical candidate; single seed checks, three-seed HGB confirmation.

local_probability_archive.contents: Final and r1 seven-class probabilities plus the r1 probability receipt and original replay spec per window.

evaluation.objective: Per-original mean of valid-horizon CE + 0.5 Brier + 0.5 normalized RPS, weighted by inverse inclusion.
evaluation.probability_replay: Checks pinned predecessor manifest, estimator/thresholds, fit and evaluation view hashes, ordered sample keys, dates, weights, masks, targets, and normalized seven-class probabilities.
evaluation.comparison: Seed-average paired objective deltas, same-month-block 95% bootstrap interval.

projection.history: Recover all 60 × 6 channels from displayed log-return, OHL distances, volumes and close anchors.
projection.scalar: Apply the same field precision, with literal formatter at decimal ties; age and sigma are recoverable.

scalar_sample_check.sample: Every 19th row of each 103,000-row window feature matrix, displayed finite numeric scalars.
